KE.note: A 2025 investigation by the Kenyan outlet Tech-ish interviewed Mindrift AI trainers working in Kenya.

source.title: Mindrift job listing text (eligibility is set per listing)

availability.note: Mindrift publishes no general country list. Each job listing names the country it is open to, and only people living there can apply. Kenya is marked accepted based on reporting on Mindrift workers there.

items.text: Each listing is only for people currently living in the country it names, and your location can affect eligibility and rates.
After you apply, the team reviews your CV. If you are a fit you take a short assessment, verify your identity through Persona, and are matched to projects when they open.
Some projects are open to everyone on the platform. Specialised projects need expertise in areas like coding, maths or writing and usually pay more.
You are paid for tasks you complete, not for time spent applying or waiting.
Task availability goes up and down.
Joining is free. Mindrift says any offer that asks you for money is not Mindrift.
